title: Nail Technician
description:
Nail Technician
Job Type  Full Time , 
Onsite 
Qualification KCSE
Experience - 3 years
Location  Kitale
Job FieldArt / Crafts / Languages 
Job Summary

We are seeking skilled and customer-focused Nail Technicians to join our team. The ideal candidate will provide high-quality nail care services while also performing eyebrow shaping and facial scrubbing treatments. Basic makeup application skills are considered a strong advantage. The candidate should have excellent hygiene practices, attention to detail, and a passion for beauty and client care.

Key Responsibilities

Nail Services

Perform professional manicures, pedicures and scrubbing.
Apply gel polish, regular polish, gum gel, stickons\tips.
Maintain nail tools and equipment according to hygiene standards.
Advise clients on proper nail care and maintenance.
Perform eyebrow shaping using appropriate techniques including henna application.
Perform basic facial scrubbing/exfoliation treatments.
Provide basic makeup application for clients when required will be an added advantage.
Client Care

Welcome and consult clients to understand their preferences and needs.
Maintain a clean, hygienic, and organized workspace.
Ensure all tools are sanitized according to salon standards.
Promote and recommend salon services and products when appropriate.
Requirements

Certification or training in nail technology or beauty therapy will be an added advantage.
Experience in manicure and pedicure services.
Ability to perform eyebrow shaping and basic facial scrubs.
Knowledge of sanitation and hygiene standards.
Good communication and customer service skills.
Friendly, professional, and detail-oriented.
Preferred (not mandatory):

Experience in basic makeup application.

Skills

Good at nail art.
Strong hygiene and sanitation practices
Good hand coordination and precision
Customer service and communication skills
Ability to work in a team environment
Working Conditions

Flexible working hours including weekends may be required.

Salary: Competitive salary compensation depending on level of experience.

Method of Application
Interested applicants to send samples of their previous work on our WhatsApp page or email and a description about them on cover letter or cv. 

Apply email: nechesadiana55@gmail.com
